items.name: button
items.title: Ray Button
items.description: A pressable arcade key that squashes on press, blooms neon on release and throws a spark burst on success. Defines <rv-button>.
items.author: rayss868 <https://github.com/rayss868>
items.docs: Ray Button is a single self-contained classic script that registers a Web Component. Load /ray-vfx/button.js with a plain <script> tag (not a module), then use the <rv-button> element. API: variant (primary|secondary|ghost), size (sm|md|lg), fx, disabled, loading, type (submit|button); click(), done(), fail(); fires click, ray:fx-start, ray:fx-end. All motion runs on spring physics and honors prefers-reduced-motion. Source: https://github.com/rayss868/ray-vfx
